channel.wecom.desc: Send messages through a WeCom group bot
channel.wecom.field.url.desc: Full webhook address of the group bot, which has to carry the key query parameter
channel.wecom.field.msgType.desc: Message type, either text or markdown, defaulting to text
channel.wecom.error.missing_key: the url has to carry a non-empty key query parameter
channel.wecom.error.invalid_url: {{.URL}} is not a valid webhook address
channel.wecom.error.invalid_msg_type: {{.Type}} is not a supported message type, use text or markdown
channel.wecom.error.empty_content: title and body are both empty
channel.wecom.error.api_code: the platform rejected the request with code {{.Code}}: {{.Message}}
channel.wecom.error.bad_response: the WeCom response could not be read: {{.Detail}}
channel.wecom.warn.truncated: message content was cut at the {{.Limit}} byte limit
